about: Mainframe ground-truth ledger (tests/tools/ground_truth_ledger.py). Every engine/forge disagreement with a hand-verified answer key, keyed '<side> | <field> | <program> | <value> | fp|fn' -> cause; every cause has a kind (defect|deliberate) and names its owning issue. CI fails on an unlisted mismatch, a listed one that no longer reproduces, an UNTRIAGED entry, a cause without an issue, or a stale scoreboard. Re-measure with `update`, triage with `assign`.

engine_dead_is_unreferenced_by_name.summary: The engine's usage_status is the unreferenced-by-name census (a unit's name occurs nowhere else in the file), not reachability. Reachability-based dead code stays on the forge by decision (docs/unreferenced_by_name_contract.md; #3348 scope note). Scoring usage_status against the key's reachability verdicts is therefore expected to disagree.

forge_units_include_copied_paragraphs.summary: The forge reads the COMPILED program: resolve_copybooks inlines every COPY, so a procedure-division copybook's paragraphs (CardDemo CSSTRPFY's YYYY-STORE-PFKEY, CSUTLDPY's EDIT-DATE-*, CSDB2RPY's 9998-PRIMING-QUERY) are units of the program that copies them. The key lists the paragraphs written in the program's own source file. Surfaced when #3414 let the COPY-with-period-on-the-next-line shape resolve; the inlining is what dead-code analysis needs.
